args.sql:
SELECT 
    d.distregistry AS disaster_id,
    d.haztype,
    d.haz_level,
    d.affectedarea,
    d.region_tag,
    d.timemark,
    -- Population impact from JSON
    (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint AS affected_population,
    (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::bigint AS displaced_population,
    -- Supply situation
    s.foodtons,
    s.water_liters,
    s.medunits,
    s.shelter_units,
    -- Supply Sufficiency (Days): LEAST((food_tons * 1000) / (affected_population * 2), water_liters / (affected_population * 3))
    ROUND(
        CAST(LEAST(
            (s.foodtons * 1000.0) / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 2, 0),
            s.water_liters / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 3, 0)
        ) AS numeric), 2
    ) AS supply_sufficiency_days,
    -- Shelter Gap: GREATEST(0, displaced_population - shelter_units)
    GREATEST(0, 
        COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::bigint, 0) - COALESCE(s.shelter_units, 0)
    ) AS shelter_gap
FROM disasterevents d
LEFT JOIN supplies s ON d.distregistry = s.supply_dist_ref
ORDER BY d.distregistry
LIMIT 10;

    d.distregistry,
    d.affectedarea,
    GREATEST(0, 
        COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::bigint, 0) - COALESCE(s.shelter_units, 0)
    ) AS shelter_gap
FROM disasterevents d
INNER JOIN supplies s ON d.distregistry = s.supply_dist_ref
WHERE s.foodtons IS NOT NULL AND s.water_liters IS NOT NULL AND (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected') IS NOT NULL
    AND LEAST(
        (s.foodtons * 1000.0) / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 2, 0),
        s.water_liters / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 3, 0)
    ) < 7
ORDER BY supply_sufficiency_days;

SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(LEAST(
        (s.foodtons * 1000.0) / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 2, 0),
        s.water_liters / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::bigint * 3, 0)

INNER JOIN supplies s ON d.distregistry = s.supply_dist_ref
WHERE s.foodtons IS NOT NULL AND s.water_liters IS NOT NULL AND (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected') IS NOT NULL
